sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: DNC Station at Bishnupur was de-commissioned on 1993, since then one LHA was posted to look after the station.

sections.title: Electricity
sections.text: Single Phase, 230V, 50Hz Electric Mains Supply is available from WBEDCL.

sections.title: Water Supply
sections.text: Digged well is available in the station.

sections.title: Mode ofApproach
sections.text: The station is well connected by all weather road. The nearest railway station is Bishnupur railway station which is approx. 2.5 Km and nearest Airport is Kolkata which is approx. 210 km from Station.

sections.title: Facilities Available
sections.text: Post Office, Primary Health Center, Police Station and High School all are within radius of 3 KM from Bishnupur DNC Station.
